items.source: Get the greatest ID as String among the pending messages.
items.translation: 获取待处理消息中最大的 ID，类型为 String。

items.source: Get the smallest ID as String among the pending messages.
items.translation: 获取待处理消息中最小的 ID，即 String。

items.source: Get the range between the smallest and greatest ID among the pending messages.
items.translation: 获取待处理消息中最小 ID 与最大 ID 之间的范围。

items.source:
Obtain a map of every consumer in the consumer group with at least one pending message, and
the number of pending messages.
items.translation: 获取每个消费者组中至少有一条待处理消息的消费者的地图，以及待处理消息的数量。

items.source: Get the number of total pending messages within the consumer group.
items.translation: 获取消费者组内待处理消息的总数。

items.source: Get the greatest ID among the pending messages.
items.translation: 获取待处理消息中最大的 ID。

items.source: Get the smallest ID among the pending messages.
items.translation: 获取待处理消息中最小的 ID。

items.source:
Value Object summarizing pending messages in a consumer group. It contains the total number and ID range
of pending messages for this consumer group, as well as a collection of total pending messages per consumer.
items.translation: 这是一个用于汇总消费者组中待处理消息的 Value 对象。它包含该消费者组的待处理消息总数及其 ID 范围，以及每个消费者的待处理消息总数集合。
